name: Barksdale AFB
description: Home of Air Force Global Strike Command and the 2nd Bomb Wing. Barksdale AFB operates B-52H Stratofortress bombers and supports global strike missions.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: West Gate (Shreveport / Main Gate)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 access with Visitor Control Center. Main entry point for visitors.
gates.address: Shreveport Rd / Barksdale Blvd, Barksdale AFB, LA 71110

gates.name: Bossier Gate (North Gate)
gates.notes: North side access with limited weekend hours.
gates.address: North Gate Rd, Barksdale AFB, LA 71110

gates.name: East Gate (Industrial Gate)
gates.notes: Primarily commercial vehicles and east reservation residents. Inbound passenger vehicles 0630-0800 M-F only.

gates.name: West Gate Visitor Control Center
gates.notes: Primary VCC for visitor passes. REAL ID required. After hours passes at West Gate.
gates.address: West Shreveport Gate, Barksdale AFB, LA 71110

gates.name: East Gate Visitor Control Center
gates.notes: Secondary VCC for east side access.

resources.name: Touch-n-Go Flight Kitchen / DFAC
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting B-52 operations and base personnel with full meal service including midnight meals.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Breakfast 0600-0900, Lunch 1030-1330, Dinner 1630-1830, Midnight 2230-0030; Sat-Sun: Breakfast 0630-0830, Lunch/Dinner 1030-1830, Midnight 2230-0000

resources.name: Barksdale Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, food court, and shoppette.
resources.address: 455 Curtiss Rd, Bldg 4711, Barksdale AFB, LA 71110

resources.name: Barksdale Federal Credit Union
resources.description: Full-service credit union branch on base with ATM.

resources.name: SrA Bell Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with weights, cardio, group exercise, and 24/7 CAC access. Iron Airman Gym also available.
resources.hours: 24/7 for registered CAC holders; staffed hours Mon-Sun 0530-2000

resources.name: Barksdale Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging including DVQ and TLF. 24/7 front desk for arrivals.
resources.address: 555 Davis Avenue West, Barksdale AFB, LA 71110

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness.
resources.address: 801 Kenney Ave, Suite 1400, Barksdale AFB, LA 71110

resources.name: 2nd Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: See directory for individual facility hours

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation
resources.description: Equipment rental, FamCamp, RV storage, archery, shotgun sports, and recreational programs.

resources.name: Fox Run Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with pro shop and snack bar.

resources.name: Bomber Alley Bowling Center
resources.description: Bowling alley with snack bar and league play.

resources.name: 2nd Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services.

primaryAction.title: West Gate Visitor Control Center
primaryAction.address: West Shreveport Gate, Barksdale AFB, LA 71110

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Barksdale Inn (318-456-3091) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 2 FSS, M&FRC, and official Barksdale sites for in-processing and Global Strike Command support.
